entities.summary: Adrianus Djajasepoetra, SJ was an Indonesian Roman Catholic prelate who served as the apostolic vicar of Jakarta and later its archbishop. Before being an apostolic vicar, Mgr. Adrianus was a rector of St. Ignatius College, Yogyakarta and the 4th rector of Major Seminary, Kentungan, Yogyakarta (1948–1949).
